title: Best Stretch
statement:
Find the largest possible sum of a **non-empty** run of consecutive elements of the array.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the largest sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
